svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 02 · Berkeley · 01/12 Sather Tower (Legendary)
svg.desc: The campanile. The bells play at noon and you can hear them from half of town. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
